name: Cajun Pork Chop with Pineapple Sauce & Spicy Cauliflower-Carrot Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 jalapeño peppers
6 medium carrots
1 ½ small pineapples

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the cauliflower. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. Divide between two baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower and carrots are tender and golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Sprinkle with Cajun seasoning on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl along with water, soy sauce, maple syrup, cornstarch, Dijon, Cajun seasoning, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
¾ cup water
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
3 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp Cajun seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the sauce.
When the pork chops are done, return skillet to medium-low heat. Add pineapple and sauce; cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and pineapple sauce between plates. Top sauce with pork and enjoy!
